code_paths.purpose: Extracts a .tar.lz4 archive from src to dst, validating inputs and archive operations at each step.

transformations: Used for reading headers and data blocks
Used for writing headers and data blocks
Pathname rewritten to be under dst
Header and data blocks written to disk

description: Provides a function to extract files from a .tar.lz4 archive to a destination directory using libarchive and Boost filesystem, with error handling.
